title: Let's Learn English Lesson 25
subtitle: Watch Out!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 25: Watch Out! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello from Washington, DC! This city has many monuments and memorials.
dialogue.zh: 你好，这里是华盛顿特区！这座城市有很多纪念碑和纪念堂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today I am visiting the ones built in memory of our Presidents: Washington, Jefferson, Lincoln and Roosevelt.
dialogue.zh: 今天我去看为总统建造的那些：华盛顿、杰斐逊、林肯和罗斯福。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want to learn more about them.
dialogue.zh: 我想多了解他们。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey! Watch out!
dialogue.zh: 嘿！小心！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Sorry! I didn't see you.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉！我没看见你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You were not looking. You should be more careful.
dialogue.zh: 你没有看路。你应该更小心。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: I know I should be more careful. But this game is really fun.
dialogue.zh: 我知道我应该更小心。可这个游戏真的很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What kind of game?
dialogue.zh: 什么样的游戏？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: You have to find things that aren't really there.
dialogue.zh: 你得找到其实不在那儿的东西。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How can you find things that aren't really there?
dialogue.zh: 不在那儿的东西怎么找？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: They're in your phone. See?
dialogue.zh: 它们在你的手机里。看见了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I see. It's like a scavenger hunt.
dialogue.zh: 我明白了。就像寻宝游戏。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: That's right!
dialogue.zh: 对！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't have time for games. I want to learn about U.S. presidents.
dialogue.zh: 我没时间玩游戏。我想了解美国总统。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Then you should play this game! When you find an American symbol, you win points and a Fun Fact about a U.S. President.
dialogue.zh: 那你更应该玩这个游戏！找到一个美国象征，你就能得分，还能得到一条美国总统趣闻。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have time for this game!
dialogue.zh: 这个游戏我有时间！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Here are the symbols that I caught: the Statue of Liberty for 20 points, Uncle Sam for 40 points and the American flag for 60 points.
dialogue.zh: 这些是我抓到的象征：自由女神像 20 分，山姆大叔 40 分，美国国旗 60 分。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What symbol are you looking for now?
dialogue.zh: 你现在在找哪个象征？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: I am looking for the bald eagle. That is 100 points! It should be near the Washington Monument.
dialogue.zh: 我在找白头海雕。那是 100 分！它应该在华盛顿纪念碑附近。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This game is awesome.
dialogue.zh: 这个游戏太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: You ought to buy the app right now. It's called "Catch Americana."
dialogue.zh: 你现在就该买这个应用。它叫“Catch Americana”。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Got it. Catch Americana.
dialogue.zh: 知道了。Catch Americana。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks! Good luck!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！祝你好运！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Good luck to you too!
dialogue.zh: 也祝你好运！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is the Jefferson Memorial. I know that Thomas Jefferson signed the Declaration of Independence! Now, where is that symbol?
dialogue.zh: 这是杰斐逊纪念堂。我知道托马斯·杰斐逊签署了《独立宣言》！现在，那个象征在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Here it is! My first one. It's an American flag! I won 60 points!
dialogue.zh: 在这儿！我的第一个。是一面美国国旗！我得了 60 分！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: An American flag works well for Thomas Jefferson. I see lots of American flags on Independence Day!
dialogue.zh: 美国国旗很适合托马斯·杰斐逊。独立日那天我会看到很多美国国旗！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Where is my Jefferson Fun Fact?
dialogue.zh: 我的杰斐逊趣闻呢？

dialogue.speaker: Voice
dialogue.en: In his lifetime, Thomas Jefferson wrote about 19,000 letters!
dialogue.zh: 托马斯·杰斐逊一生大约写了 19,000 封信！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I did not know that. Where is the next symbol?
dialogue.zh: 我以前不知道。下一个象征在哪里？

What symbol does Anna catch first?
